exposure: longer stage II and III of labor
vaginal delivery with the curettage of the uterine cavity
Duration of labor stages II and III
cohort: 75 women with EPDS scores ≥ 12 (study group) and 75 women with EPDS scores ≤ 5 (control group) hospitalized in the Teaching Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics of Professor Orłowski Hospital in Warsaw, Poland, between 2010 and 2017.
finding: Women with blood loss >1000 mL, longer stage II and III labor, cesarean section, vaginal delivery with curettage, lower APGAR scores, and lower birth weight had an increased risk of developing postpartum mood disorders.
mod_finding: Women at low risk of postpartum mood disorders more commonly underwent episiotomy during delivery.
birth_weight: Mentioned, but no specific values given.
